title: OpenZeppelin v4.9+ Virtual Shares / Decimal Offset Defense
apparent_vulnerability: Vault allows direct token transfers and starts with 0 assets and 0 shares.
mitigating_mechanism: ERC4626 implementation adds virtual shares and virtual assets in calculations via _decimalsOffset(), rendering the donation ratio mathematically ineffective.
why_attack_fails: The denominator totalAssets() + 1 and numerator offset 10 ** _decimalsOffset() prevents zero-share rounding. An attacker attempting a 1 wei donation attack would lose orders of magnitude more capital than any extractable yield.
